Taste the delightful sweetness of Golden apples, a fruit that combines a crisp texture with a luscious flavor. Ideal for snacking, baking, or adding to salads, Golden apples are a versatile choice for any meal. Rich in antioxidants and dietary fiber, they support your overall health. Enjoy them fresh or cooked in your favorite recipes!

Delight in the sweet and tangy flavor of Mosambi, a citrus fruit that brings a refreshing twist to your palate. Known for its juiciness and zesty aroma, Mosambi is perfect for juicing or enjoying fresh. Rich in vitamin C, this fruit boosts your immune system and supports overall health. Squeeze it into a refreshing drink or enjoy it as a healthy snack!

Delight in the rich, savory flavor of Shiitake mushrooms, a culinary favorite known for their meaty texture and distinct umami taste. Perfect for stir-fries, soups, or as a topping for pizzas, these mushrooms add depth and richness to any dish. Packed with vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants, Shiitake mushrooms are a nutritious addition to your diet. Enjoy them sautéed with garlic, added to hearty broths, or incorporated into pasta dishes for an earthy flavor. Their unique taste and health benefits make Shiitake mushrooms a delightful choice for your meals!

Green grapes are oval-shaped and small, round berries with smooth skin, a peppy flavour, and translucent flesh. These grapes have a slightly crunchy texture and a sweet, tart taste. You can eat green grapes in breakfast, after lunch, or use them to make juices with any combination of fruits. You can also try some new dishes with green grapes like a cheesy snack platter that includes cheese, crackers, and other fruits to enjoy exotic flavours.

Cilantro is famous for its warm, spicy, and nutty flavour. Fresh cilantro/ dhania is a common ingredient used in salads, salsa, and curries and all the world's leading cuisines, especially in all the national foods of Pakistan. The aroma and taste of cilantro enhances the flavour of your dishes. Fresh cilantro is very low in cholesterol and has saturated fats. Its caloric value is nearly non-existent. It is a rich source of dietary fiber, calcium, iron, and vitamins A, C, E, and K.

Delight in the sweet and tender taste of Matar, fresh peas that add a burst of flavor and nutrition to your meals. Known for their vibrant green color and crisp texture, these peas are perfect for soups, stews, or salads, bringing freshness and sweetness to every dish. Rich in vitamins and fiber, peas support digestive health and overall well-being. Enjoy them fresh, frozen, or cooked for a nutritious addition to your diet. Whether tossed in a salad or blended into a puree, peas are a delightful and healthy choice!

Savor the mild, slightly sweet flavor of Mara Kadoo, also known as zucchini, a versatile vegetable perfect for a range of dishes. With its tender flesh and light green skin, zucchini is ideal for grilling, sautéing, or spiralizing, making it a healthy alternative to pasta. Low in calories and high in nutrients, zucchini can be enjoyed in salads, baked goods, or as a comforting side. Enjoy it fresh in salads or cooked with spices for a delicious and nutritious addition to your meals. Its versatility makes Mara Kadoo a favorite in many kitchens!

A keepsake for your happily ever after. Gilded Forever brings together a soft ivory resin base, shimmering gold-tone details and personalised lettering to celebrate the beginning of your life together.
Design details
Round resin plaque with an organic, gently rippled edge.
Ivory centre with scattered gold-tone and silver-tone flakes.
Richly decorated border featuring clear and gold-tone chips with pearl-style beads.
Gold-tone lettering with a romantic message, couple names and wedding date.
Personalisation
Provide the couple’s names and your preferred date exactly as you would like them to appear. Names and date shown in the photograph are examples.
Production & delivery
Made to order. Please allow approximately 7–10 working days for production, plus delivery time.
Care
Handle gently and dust with a soft dry cloth. Keep away from water, direct sunlight and excessive heat.

A keepsake of your promise, made personal. Ivory Ahd combines a softly textured ivory resin base with cream floral detailing, pearl-style beads and gold-tone accents for a cherished reminder of your Nikkah.
Design details
Rounded resin plaque with an organic decorative edge.
Asymmetrical cream floral arrangement with pearl-style beads.
Clear and gold-tone decorative chips framing the plaque.
Gold-tone Arabic calligraphy, personalised names and wedding date.
Two outlined thumbprint spaces joined by a heart motif.
Personalisation
Provide the couple’s names and preferred date exactly as you would like them to appear. Names and date shown in the photograph are examples.
Production & delivery
Made to order. Please allow approximately 7–10 working days for production, plus delivery time.
Care
Handle gently and dust with a soft dry cloth. Keep away from water, direct sunlight and excessive heat.

Mark a cherished spiritual journey with Noor Al Hajj, a personalised Hajj Mubarak keepsake in rich black and gold tones. A thoughtful gift to welcome loved ones home and commemorate their pilgrimage.
Design details
Glossy black resin plaque with an irregular rectangular silhouette and gold-tone edging.
Textured border featuring black and clear decorative chips, gold-tone accents and pearl-style beads.
Gold-tone Arabic calligraphy and a warm Hajj blessing.
Personalised names and commemorative date.
Personalisation
Provide the recipient names and preferred date exactly as you would like them to appear. For a Hijri date, please provide the complete day, month and year. Names and date shown in the photograph are examples.
Production & delivery
Made to order. Please allow approximately 7–10 working days for production, plus delivery time.
Care
Handle gently and dust with a soft dry cloth. Keep away from water, direct sunlight and excessive heat.

Let your Nikkah day bloom into a keepsake.
Blossom Gold
is a personalised resin wedding plaque with a luminous pearlescent white base, a scalloped gold-tone edge and floral arrangements in vivid pink, soft blush and cream. Gold-tone flakes and pearl-style accents frame your names and wedding date, making it a meaningful centrepiece for your ceremony and a beautiful reminder afterwards.
Design details
Pearlescent white resin with a softly textured, light-catching finish.
Raised floral details arranged around the edge in pink, blush and cream.
A scalloped gold-tone border with scattered gold-tone flakes and pearl-style embellishments.
Personalised names and wedding date. The sample features gold-tone Arabic calligraphy, an English translation and burgundy names.
Available in 8-inch, 10-inch and 12-inch sizes.
Personalise your plaque
Choose your size and enter your names and wedding date using the product options. Select your preferred wording and available text options, checking spellings, dates and Arabic text carefully before checkout. Names and dates shown in the photos are examples and will be replaced with your details. For a different flower colour palette or a specific verse, contact us to confirm availability before ordering.
What is included?
The displayed price is for the personalised plaque only.
Handles and ring holders / ring boxes are optional paid add-ons and are not included in the base price. Choose available accessories separately to complete your set.
Production and delivery
Each Blossom Gold plaque is handmade to order. Please allow
7–10 working days for production
, plus delivery time. If your event date is approaching, check availability with us before placing your order. Slight variations in floral placement and resin patterns are part of the handmade finish.
Care
Dust gently with a soft cloth and handle the raised floral details carefully. Avoid soaking, abrasive cleaners, excessive heat and prolonged direct sunlight.
Need help with your wording, colour preferences or event date?
Chat with us on WhatsApp
for assistance, then complete your order through checkout.

A timeless promise, captured in ruby and gold.
Ruby Promise pairs a rich burgundy, marbled finish with elegant gold-tone lettering. Its softly irregular round shape is framed by a textured deep-red border, delicate gold-tone edging and pearl-style accents—a romantic keepsake for your Nikkah day and the years that follow.
Personalised for your story
Add the couple’s names, your special date and preferred wording. The photographed design features Bismillah, a Quranic verse with an English translation, an infinity symbol and a delicate hand illustration. Share your requested details in the personalisation box and check all names and dates before ordering.

Textured red border with gold-tone accents.
Pearl-style embellishments around the edge.
Personalised gold-tone lettering.
Made to order
Prepared in approximately 7–10 working days, with delivery time additional. Each handmade piece may have small variations in pattern and decorative placement.
Care
Wipe gently with a soft cloth. Keep away from prolonged direct sunlight, excessive heat, harsh chemicals and heavy impact. Intended as a decorative keepsake.

A romantic keepsake for the day you say Qubool Hai. Crimson Vow pairs a gleaming mirror base with deep red roses, delicate cream floral accents and gold-tone lettering, creating a lasting reminder of your Nikkah.

Ignite your culinary creations with the fiery taste of German green chillies, known for their vibrant color and spicy flavor. Perfect for enhancing the heat in curries, salsas, or marinades, these chillies are a must-have for spice lovers. Rich in vitamins and antioxidants, green chillies support overall health while adding a satisfying kick to your dishes. Use them fresh, dried, or as a spice to elevate your favorite recipes. Whether you prefer them chopped in sauces or blended into fiery condiments, German green chillies will undoubtedly bring a flavorful punch to your meals!

Available in various colors, including green, red, and yellow, these peppers are perfect for stir-fries, salads, or stuffed dishes. Their crisp texture and juicy sweetness make them a favorite in many cuisines, enhancing the flavor and visual appeal of your dishes. Rich in vitamins A and C, Shimla capsicum supports your immune system and overall health. Enjoy them fresh in salads, sautéed for a flavorful side, or roasted for a delicious addition to pasta dishes. Their versatility makes them a must-have in any kitchen!

Elevate your dishes with the zesty, citrus flavor of our Lemon Grass Stick. Ideal for soups, curries, and teas, this aromatic herb adds a refreshing, tangy note to both savory and sweet recipes.

The flavour of fresh sweet melon is too good to miss. Its sweet smell sparks an exotic desire to devour all of it. It doesn't only appease the taste buds but also offers a wide range of health benefits. It is an excellent source of dietary fiber, which is surprising due to its high-water content. It aids digestion and fills you up, making it a health-conscious person's best friend. It is the best treat of summers due to its calming and soothing effects.

Add a burst of sweetness and color to your meals with yellow bell peppers, a delicious vegetable that’s perfect for a variety of dishes. Known for their juicy flesh and mild flavor, these peppers are ideal for salads, stir-fries, or stuffed dishes. Rich in vitamins A and C, yellow bell peppers support immune health and promote glowing skin. Enjoy them fresh in salads, grilled for a smoky flavor, or roasted for a sweet, caramelized taste. Their vibrant color and sweetness make yellow bell peppers a favorite in many kitchens!

Savor the unique taste and nutritional benefits of Brussels sprouts, a cruciferous vegetable known for its nutty flavor and delightful crunch. These small, round vegetables can be roasted, steamed, or sautéed, providing a healthy side dish or addition to salads. Packed with vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants, Brussels sprouts support immune health and overall well-being. Enjoy them roasted with olive oil for a caramelized flavor or sautéed with garlic for a savory side. Their versatility and rich flavor make Brussels sprouts a nutritious choice for any meal!

Experience the sweetness and vibrant color of red bell peppers, a delicious addition to any dish. Known for their juicy flesh and mild flavor, these peppers are perfect for snacking, sautéing, or adding to salads. Rich in vitamins A and C, red bell peppers support immune health and promote glowing skin. Enjoy them fresh as a crunchy snack, roasted for a smoky flavor, or stuffed with your favorite fillings. Their versatility and sweetness make red bell peppers a favorite in kitchens worldwide!
